raw_segments.text: Gloucester, because I would not see thy cruel nails pluck out his poor old eyes, nor thy
fierce sister in his anointed flesh stick boorish fangs.
The sea, with such a storm as his bare head and hell-black night endured, would have buoyed
up and quenched the stelled fires, yet poor old heart he halt the heavens to rain.
If wolves had at thy gate howled that stern time, thou shouldst have said, Good porter,
All cruel's else subscript, but I shall see the winged vengeance overtake such children.
